records.title: Flow-field navigation per body size
records.summary: One clearance grid; a Dijkstra cost field per body-size class seeded round the target, at most one field rebuilt per frame; each mover walks downhill to the furthest cell in plain sight, then bends its heading onto obstacle tangents. Cheap for hundreds of chasers.

records.title: Wave director on a point budget
records.summary: budget(w)=9+3.2w spent on a weighted enemy pool by cost; split into groups sent on an interval or when the field is empty; max-alive cap; boss every 5th wave with the rest at 55%; party size scales foes and life.

records.title: Fixed pool of point lights
records.summary: Eight PointLights made once; flash() takes a free one or steals the oldest, fades by life, can follow an object. The light count never changes, so no shader ever recompiles mid-game.

records.title: Instanced skinned crowds
records.summary: Every creature of a kind is one instanced draw: joint matrices and per-body looks (dissolve, frozen, hit flash, rim colour) are rows of a float texture read with gl_InstanceID, injected through onBeforeCompile.

records.title: Cloth with position-based dynamics
records.summary: Rings of particles (28×7), verlet at 60 Hz with 3 iterations of distance constraints (ring, down, shear, bend), a tether to the top ring and a capsule collider for the arm. Works for sleeves, capes, banners.

records.title: Verlet ragdolls
records.summary: Bodies handed to a small verlet solver on death: points, stick constraints, ground contact, then written back to the bones.

records.title: SDF sculpting meshed with surface nets
records.summary: Shapes as signed distance fields (smooth unions), meshed once with surface nets, textured triplanar, skinned with dual quaternions so joints do not collapse.

records.title: Weapon swing trails
records.summary: A ribbon through Catmull-Rom points sampled from the blade tip and base each frame, fading along its length, additive.

records.title: Pooled CPU particles
records.summary: Fixed-size pools drawn as one instanced mesh or points; emit() overwrites the oldest; no allocation while playing.

records.title: Frame pacing and auto quality
records.summary: Measure frame time over a window; step a quality preset down or up with hysteresis; change only what needs no shader change.

records.title: Sound design that carries on laptop speakers
records.summary: Weight goes in the mids, not sub-bass: cut under 120 Hz after the drive stage; a blow needs 0.3 s of decay to read as a blow; spells play no notes (they clash with the music); one generated hall reverb whose noise darkens as it decays; crackle textures from random impulses.

records.title: World labels drawn in WebGL
records.summary: Damage numbers, names and bars painted into one canvas atlas and drawn as a single instanced batch, not DOM nodes.

records.title: See-through walls and line-of-sight blackout
records.summary: Screen-door dissolve of whatever stands between the camera and the hero; a 360° sight polygon blacks out what the hero cannot see.

records.title: Shaders compiled at load, never mid-game
records.summary: Every material variant is rendered once off-screen at load and pinned; loading is cut into short chunks; heavy textures are made in workers.

records.title: Bank-or-risk loot
records.summary: Loot found in a run stays in a bag until banked between waves; dying forfeits the bag; rarity weights rise each wave.

records.title: Deterministic fixed-tick simulation
records.summary: Fixed 20 Hz, a seeded generator, never reads render state, the clock or Math.random. The same seed and commands always give the same game, so saves, replays, rewinding, lockstep play and headless tests all come from one sim.

records.title: Lockstep multiplayer with a desync hash
records.summary: Only commands cross the wire; each runs at tick T+delay (delay adapts 2–15 ticks); a relay closes each tick; clients compare a hash of the state every so often; trig functions replaced by portable versions so engines agree to the last bit.

records.title: Replays you can scrub and take over
records.summary: Store seed + command stream + periodic hashes; scrub by re-simulating from the nearest snapshot; watch through any player's fog; "take command" starts a new game from that moment.

records.title: Grid A* with generation counters
records.summary: 8-connected, no corner cutting; visited/closed arrays stamped with a search number instead of being cleared; remembers the nearest reachable cell as a fallback; path smoothed by line-of-sight string pulling.

records.title: Formations that keep their shape
records.summary: A virtual centre walks one path; slots laid out in rows (line, box, wedge), sorted by role with armour in front and by current side so nobody crosses; blocked slots squeeze towards the centre; the group waits for stragglers.

records.title: Fog of war with a soft, drifting edge
records.summary: The sim stamps circles into visible/explored grids; the renderer eases them into a texture (visible 5/s, explored 3/s) and the ground shader samples it with a noise offset: fogged = desaturated cool tint, shroud = dark clouds with a faint rim.

records.title: Trauma screen shake
records.summary: trauma 0..1 rises with kicks and decays steadily; amplitude = max × trauma^1.3, scaled by camera distance; the offset is a sum of two unrelated sines per axis; reduced-motion sets it to zero.

records.title: Game-feel director
records.summary: One place owns shake, a "clash" meter fed by nearby fighting that drives music intensity, and brief slow-motion on big moments.

records.title: Procedural models as one skinned draw
records.summary: Build a model as a node tree; every node with body geometry becomes a bone and all body parts merge into one skinned mesh (one draw call); turrets and doors move by moving bones; ambient occlusion, edge wear, snow and mud baked into vertex colours; a far LOD body.

records.title: Vertex-animation-texture crowds
records.summary: Animation clips baked into a texture (one row per frame, one column per vertex); thousands of instanced soldiers play and cross-fade clips in the vertex shader.

records.title: GPU particles
records.summary: Positions and velocities live in float textures stepped by a ping-pong pass; 8k–64k particles in one draw, colliding with a terrain height texture.

records.title: Hundreds of lights without THREE.Light
records.summary: Lights binned into a screen-tile grid and applied in one full-screen pass; muzzle flashes and explosions each get one.

records.title: Buildings that break apart
records.summary: Pre-cut a building into Voronoi chunks bound to bones of one skinned mesh; a small rigid-body solver drops them; craters scar the ground texture.

records.title: Gerstner water and ship wakes
records.summary: Sum of Gerstner waves for the surface; Kelvin-V wakes drawn into a texture behind each ship.

records.title: Weather in a camera-following volume
records.summary: Rain and snow are a fixed box of points round the camera, wrapped and animated in the vertex shader; lightning bolts by midpoint subdivision.

records.title: Landmarks and towns from a grammar
records.summary: A small kit (walls, storeys, roof types) plus rules builds whole towns; landmarks are hand-written recipes on the same kit.

records.title: Fair map generation
records.summary: Generate one sector and mirror it for symmetric skirmish maps; check path lengths and resources per start, re-roll if unfair.

records.title: Skirmish AI without cheating
records.summary: Sees only what its fog shows; a personality vector (aggression, greed, tech) weights choices; plans operations (harass, push, defend) and counters what it has scouted; named rivals remember how you played.

records.title: Seeded adaptive music
records.summary: Three layers (calm, build, battle) cross-faded by an intensity 0..1; sections generated from tables of progressions, kick/bass/lead rhythms; lead melody = a motif walked in scale degrees, snapped to chord tones on strong beats, varied over four phrases; stingers in the current key on the beat; scheduler looks ahead and skips when the tab was throttled.

records.title: Sound effects rendered once, offline
records.summary: Each effect is a recipe (pitched thump + crack + filtered noise + metal partials) rendered in an OfflineAudioContext with a generated reverb, normalised, kept as buffers in a few variations; one recipe takes a size 0..1 from pistol to howitzer; a mixer steals voices by priority.

records.title: RTS controls on mouse, touch and pad
records.summary: Box select, control groups, layout-aware keys; touch: hold-then-drag selects, radial menu, pinch/twist camera; pad: virtual cursor and radial menu.

records.title: 3D globe campaign map
records.summary: One shader draws spherical Voronoi territories from a lookup texture of the nearest sites; a 2D canvas overlay carries badges; battle odds computed exactly.

records.title: Accessibility for games
records.summary: Colour-blind-safe team palettes (Okabe–Ito), subtitles for sounds, reduced motion, UI scale, no large flash faster than ~1.5 a second.

records.title: Talking 3D avatar as a web component
records.summary: A custom element that loads a rigged GLB, plays an idle (breathing, blinks, glances), drives mouth morph targets from audio loudness or visemes, and retargets animations between skeletons by bone-name maps.

records.title: Entity-component-system layout
records.summary: Entities are ids; components are plain arrays per type; systems are functions run in a fixed order over queries; scenes are data. Keeps game rules, rendering and UI apart.

records.title: Pixel-perfect camera
records.summary: Render the world at a fixed low resolution and scale by a whole number; snap the camera to whole pixels and carry the remainder as a sub-pixel offset of the final blit so scrolling stays smooth.
